ios._setup_instructions: 1. Log in at appstoreconnect.apple.com → Users & Access → copy your Apple ID email. 2. Go to Apps → your app → General → App Information → copy Apple ID (numeric). 3. Go to developer.apple.com → Membership → copy Team ID.

android._setup_instructions: 1. Go to Google Cloud Console → IAM → Service Accounts → Create. 2. Grant 'Service Account User' role. 3. Create JSON key → download to project root as google-service-account.json. 4. In Google Play Console → Setup → API access → link the service account.
